[P2] Revisit the untested environment branch

Rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it,” is not satisfied here. The added tests cover command construction but never call `run_test_runner` or assert its subprocess environment. Inverting this guard leaves those tests passing while removing Jest’s required VM-module flag. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and establish which observable behavior requires this distinction and how any retained branch will be tested.
